conclusion: Geometry measurements are not proof of useful steering; no operator promoted.
scope: Development only; tasks and original independent-state counts remain separate.

decision_evidence.sample_scope: 4 repeatedly reused DEVELOPMENT initial states, 64 fixed plans per state; not n=256 independent episodes.
decision_evidence.heldout_performance: Untested for these operators; baseline collection does not establish held-out intervention efficacy.

objective_alignment.scope: Technical/decision-cost diagnostic using true future encodings, not a deployable operator.
objective_alignment.interpretation: Even actual-future encoding cost need not choose the best physical outcome. Encoder-distance accuracy is not task-utility alignment.

technical_findings: Action-responsive rank4 edits and their controls: all selected-plan coverage gains are zero.
P5 output-dose calibration was feasible on all252 noncentral candidates; calibrated positive yields mean +0.460pp in1/4 states, gate fails.
Complement removal: pointwise XY span-only mean +1.160pp in2/4 states, exactly the same coverage gains as its rotated control; gate fails.
Complement energy/contrast and geometric readability are descriptive mechanisms, not held-out physical performance.

decision_evidence.conclusion: No confirmed leaderboard or promoted operator; retain every measured arm and all nulls.
